tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows a saturating response to u_now and indicates a thermal-fin bridge, but cannot distinguish the bridge law or identify its other input dependencies. The open-branch probe is the least-cost targeted measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary model from the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All rows share the same state, gradient, and horizon, so the bridge mechanism and its dependence on other inputs are not identifiable.
The cheaper open-branch probe directly targets the unresolved mechanism.
It is not relevant to distinguishing the candidate mechanisms.
